newsitem.title: UK: UK TASS fund unit introduces fund rating system.
newsitem.headline: UK TASS fund unit introduces fund rating system.

text.p: Global Fund Analysis, the trading name for TASS Management Ltd, has developed a qualitative fund rating system for offshore funds to be incorporated in its monthly research reports.
A statement from TASS said the rating is based on a combination of the stability of the management group, risk management procedures and the consistency of the investment style and fund performance.
Each fund is scored out of 20 and then rated on a scale of one to five stars.

"Global Fund Analysis has introduced its rating system because it believes a rating system to be an essential facet of any investment research service and because there are large areas of the offshore fund market where no ratings are currently published," a statement said.
The ratings will be applied to the funds in the variety of sectors it covers, including traditional and non-traditional funds from all sectors of the offshore fund market.
